summary.motive: Conflict the apex/overhang defender with a simultaneous inside zone run and perimeter bubble screen, taking whatever the defense concedes with ruthless efficiency.
summary.whyItWorks: The defense cannot be right: if the Nickel defender fits the box to stop the inside zone, the perimeter bubble screen has a 2-on-2 numerical advantage with lead blockers. If the Nickel widens, the running back gains 6+ yards on inside zone.
summary.failureMode: A lightning-fast Nickel DB who feigns a run fit before darting outside to jump the bubble screen for a pick-six.

beats.title: Spread RPO Pre-Snap Alignment
beats.text: Steichen aligns in 11 Gun Spread with a 2-man bubble screen combination to the field, putting the apex Nickel defender in direct spatial conflict.

beats.title: The Nickel Conflict Trigger
beats.text: RB attacks the A-gap on inside zone. Seeing the run look, the Nickel DB abandons his perimeter leverage and sprints downhill into the B-gap.

beats.title: The Lightning QB Pull & Throw
beats.text: QB reads the Nickel crashing, immediately pulls the ball from the mesh, and fires a lightning-fast strike to H on the perimeter bubble screen.

beats.title: Perimeter Blocks & 14-Yard Explosive Burst
beats.text: TE and Z execute textbook perimeter stalk blocks on the SS and RCB, allowing H to cut untouched up the sideline for a 14-yard gain.

relations.tell: Playside WRs immediately stalk block on snap while slot WR flares on bubble arc; QB catches and throws at mesh.
